name: student-unboxed-live-strap
exporter: Hand-written SVG in a text editor
story: A student wrote a stream's top strap by hand: a guest's name on the left and a LIVE label set flush right on the same baseline, with a thin rule under the pair and no shape behind either line. The name grows rightwards and LIVE grows leftwards, towards each other.
idioms: no shape behind any text: both lines float on the frame
a start-anchored line and an end-anchored line on one baseline, growing towards each other
a hairline drawn as a stroked <line>, which has no height of its own
whyThisMatters: Two lines with no box each take their room from what is drawn beside them, and here what is beside each is the other, which also grows. Bounded by where the other was drawn, two long values painted over each other with nothing reported (review of 2026-11-20). They now share the gap, and this file is the one in the corpus where the fit-rungs neighbour check reaches a line with no box. The growth answer is null because there is no rectangle to grow.
